name: turnosmart
description: SaaS para gestion inteligente de turnos con prediccion de no-show.

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.build:render: npm ci --include=dev --workspace=apps/backend --workspace=packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:install && npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration --workspace=apps/backend
